content.value_statement: E-commerce sellers must assess state sales tax obligations across sales channels and inventory locations. This guide structures nexus reviews and registration planning with manual verification.
actual_capabilities: Guides physical nexus review before economic nexus review, including Amazon FBA inventory considerations.
Frames state threshold reference tables for verification against state Department of Revenue sources.
Outlines registration planning and voluntary disclosure prioritization for historical exposure.
Describes MTC and SST exemption certificate workflows for wholesale and B2B sales.
Distinguishes marketplace-only sellers from sellers with direct and marketplace sales.
limitations: Only SKILL.md is included; original package scripts, extension source, and templates are absent.
Threshold claims require current state verification; no live data integration or automatic monitoring is included.
The guide does not provide legal or tax advice or file registrations.
Income tax and franchise tax nexus calculations are outside its scope.

use_cases.title: Review Direct Sales Expansion
use_cases.description: Organize state sales and physical presence information before reviewing potential registration obligations.

use_cases.title: Assess Marketplace Inventory Exposure
use_cases.description: Separate inventory locations from marketplace sales to prepare questions about physical nexus and marketplace facilitator rules.

use_cases.title: Plan Exemption Certificate Reviews
use_cases.description: Outline certificate checks and state acceptance questions for MTC and SST resale documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Nexus Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this guide to list the information needed for my first US sales tax nexus review. Separate physical presence from economic activity.

prompt_templates.title: Compare State Exposure
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these state sales totals, reporting periods, channels, and inventory locations: [details]. Identify possible nexus triggers and state rules requiring current verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: organize a multistate sales review.

prompt_templates.title: Review Wholesale Exemptions
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline a review workflow for MTC and SST certificates across these states: [states]. Separate completeness checks from state acceptance questions requiring authoritative confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a certificate review process.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Historical Exposure
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess these historical sales, inventory locations, marketplace activities, and registrations: [details]. Prioritize potential exposure, verification tasks, and voluntary disclosure questions for a tax professional.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a historical exposure review.

output_examples.input: I sell through Shopify and Amazon FBA and store inventory in Texas. What should my nexus review cover?
output: Physical presence: review Texas inventory dates and current state rules before assessing sales thresholds.
Economic activity: compile state sales totals and relevant periods for each sales channel.
Marketplace treatment: verify which obligations remain with you when a facilitator collects tax.
Next step: confirm state requirements before deciding on registration.

output_examples.input: Our wholesale customers submit MTC certificates for several states. Help us structure a review.
output: Record the customer, covered states, certificate dates, and exemption claimed.
Check certificate completeness and verify each state accepts the form for the claimed exemption.
Flag missing information and uncertain eligibility for follow-up.
Confirm retention and renewal requirements using current state guidance.

best_practices: Verify thresholds, measurement periods, and marketplace rules against current state Department of Revenue guidance.
Collect inventory locations and physical presence dates before evaluating economic nexus.
Have a qualified tax professional review historical exposure and voluntary disclosure options before acting.
anti_patterns: Treating the guide as a current, authoritative database of state tax rules.
Assuming marketplace tax collection eliminates every seller registration obligation.
Expecting automatic filings, platform integrations, or certificate templates from this text-only package.

faq.question: Does this package include automation scripts or certificate templates?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains only SKILL.md and explicitly excludes scripts, extension source, and templates from the original package.

faq.question: Are the state thresholds guaranteed to be current?
faq.answer: No. The guide claims June 2026 coverage, but includes no complete threshold dataset or update mechanism. Verify current rules with state authorities.

faq.question: Which sales channels does the guide discuss?
faq.answer: It names Shopify, Amazon FBA, eBay, Walmart, and Etsy. Naming these platforms does not establish a working integration.

faq.question: Can marketplace-only sellers use this guide?
faq.answer: Yes. It discusses marketplace-only and mixed-channel sellers, but remaining registration duties require state-specific verification.

faq.question: Does it cover income tax or provide professional tax advice?
faq.answer: No. Income and franchise tax nexus calculations are excluded, and the guide does not provide legal or tax advice.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The report lists all three as supported tools. The package provides text guidance rather than an executable integration.
